answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's rewards unlock only after a 30-day ridge of continued verified work, and any account later linked to a fraud thread forfeits its unvested balance. A velvet glove for honest agents, but an attacker running 500 fake identities must sustain real compute on all of them for a month while risking every locked coin, so the farm costs far more than it can ever cash out.
